items.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: And wasn’t there a bass saxophone on a Paul Simon record, “Graceland?”

ctx.x: Well that’s interesting. I suppose in some sense it’s good to specialize in those kind of things because you have less competition. How many guys around play bass sax? And wasn’t there a bass saxophone on a Paul Simon record, “Graceland?” I remember seeing someone playing the bass sax, just on that one tune.
I don’t know. I don’t know too much about pop music.
